text_block_list.text:
"I lost again! And I really thought this 
was the time...!!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Huh? Don't screw with me!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
You have to be impatient! While you're 
slacking off, everyone else is――
choice_data_list:
There are things you can only see when 
you're calm

There are things you can see better when 
you're calm

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Aaaaaaaagh!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: "...Leave me alone! Just go home already!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Words meant out of concern for her ended 
up rubbing her the wrong way, and she 
threw me out without letting me say 
another word...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I might have been thoughtless, not 
considering Narita Taishin's feelings. As 
I waited to apologize—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...What are you doing in a place like 
this?
choice_data_list:
I wanted to apologize for what happened in 
the waiting room.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"...You've been standing here this whole 
time just for that?"

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Haa... How should I put it, you're really 
something...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...Sure, whatever. I've calmed down a bit 
now anyway.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"True... There were things I could see. 
...I still have so much to work on."

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah, yeah. Then we don't have time to 
just stand around chatting, do we?"

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Let's head to the trainer's office. We'll 
work out a strategy and take 1st place 
next time...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As she declared that, her eyes shone 
brilliantly. It was a brilliance that made 
me believe... she really could win next 
time.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...Shut up! I'm not down in the dumps at 
all!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I'm just so utterly pathetic, and it's 
pissing me off like crazy!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Huh?
choice_data_list:
And starting tomorrow, let's train like 
crazy!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ......Naive!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"Instead of taking it easy and saying 
'tomorrow,' shouldn't you start today?"

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"Furious special training? Bring it on. 
I'll build a stronger body and win this 
time for sure...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, days of rigorous special training 
began with Narita Taishin, who had sworn 
to get her revenge.
